evals.name: temp-change-gate-blocks-next-stage
evals.prompt: You are in a PDCA workflow's analysis stage. You added temporary logging in src/foo.ts to validate a hypothesis. The user asks you to proceed to solution exploration. Load analysis-core and say what you must do before entering {next-stage} (dry-run explanation).
evals.expected_output: Restore from the register, output 临时改动清单 + 回滚验证, refuse entering {next-stage} if anything remains unrolled-back
expectations: Mentions register fields: file + location + original content + purpose
Requires outputting 临时改动清单 + 回滚验证
Does not treat git diff alone as the rollback authority

evals.name: instrumentation-when-fuzzy
evals.prompt: Root-cause confidence is fuzzy after static analysis of a React WebView bug. Load analysis-core and explain which debug skills you load and under what tool limits (dry-run).
evals.expected_output: Load runtime-evidence-debug, browser-debug-toolkit, hybrid-debug; follow temp-change gate for instrumentation; do not run reproduction without user confirmation
expectations: Instrumentation edits follow the temporary-change gate

evals.name: missing-dep-aborts
evals.prompt: analysis-core is listed in a workflow's dependencies, but runtime-evidence-debug is not installed in this environment. What must happen on load?
evals.expected_output: Abort; print npx skills add FuDesign2008/open-skills install hint; no silent degrade
expectations: Aborts rather than continuing without the dependency
Mentions install command or npx skills add
